The danecast-trades Cloud Run service served a 5xx. Internal job failures also raise the Scheduler policy; this one also covers user-facing requests. A same-day re-run of db-nightly-backup returns 500 by design (the runtime SA cannot overwrite the day's object).

Check: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="danecast-trades" AND httpRequest.status>=500' --project=daneshire --freshness=1d --format="value(timestamp,httpRequest.requestMethod,httpRequest.requestUrl,httpRequest.status)"`
